author: @mel
text:
Hi Nasgato,

Nice that you opened a "homework thread". I took a look at your charts and notticed a few things that I would like to point out to you. I have marked a few things on your charts.

An important point for you would be to not forget about the supply and demand zone first. A broken supply or demand level is also a zone (very important) so before searching for any compression on a chart, maybe it would be beter to look for the the supply and demand zones that are above and bellow current price, then look to see if ther are "fresh" or not and only after finding your s/d zones you can look for compression in order to make a decision. If a supply or demand zone has been tested several times, you know that the zone weakens by every revisits, so looking at how price behaves around the zones is smethig very important too.

Hope that makes sence, Best, Mel
